It looks like you pasted the bridge pairing command here into the chat! Here is what you need to know depending on what you're trying to do:

### 1. If you are trying to connect your computer to the mobile app
That command is meant to be run in the **Terminal** app on your computer (Mac, PC, or Linux), not inside this chat:
1. Open **Terminal** (Mac/Linux) or **PowerShell** (Windows) on your computer.
2. Navigate to your local project folder:
   ```bash
   cd /path/to/your/project
   ```
3. Run the bridge command:
   ```bash
   npx antigravity-gemini-bridge@latest
   ```
4. Follow the prompt/link to pair your computer with the mobile app.

---

### 2. If you want to build directly in this cloud workspace
**You don't need to run the bridge at all!** 

You are already connected to your cloud environment (synced with your repository [`Rith2k24/first-project`](https://github.com/Rith2k24/first-project)). 

Simply tell me what you'd like to create (e.g. a website, landing page, portfolio, web app, or game), and I will build it for you directly. You can view your live preview anytime here:
